A '''permanent pilot''' is a "built-in" pilot aboard a [[Starship]] or [[Vehicle]], shown by a pilot icon on the card. Permanent pilots are not characters and take on none of a character's features (Rebel, spy, ability, game text and so on) except those stated. For example, the permanent pilot of •Red Leader In Red 1 is not a leader. A permanent pilot provides ability only when the card's game text says so.<ref name="ar">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), Chapter 9, "Starships - permanent pilot".</ref> When a starship's or vehicle's game text is canceled, the ability its permanent pilots provide is unaffected.<ref name="cancel">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), Chapter 1, "Canceling Game Text".</ref>
